title.native: ティアムーン帝国物語～断頭台から始まる、姫の転生逆転ストーリー～

synonyms: บันทึกเรื่องราวจักรวรรดิเทียร์มูน: จุดพลิกผันชะตากรรมของเจ้าหญิงเริ่มจากบนกิโยติน
Hikayat Kekaisaran Tearmoon ~Cerita Putri yang Reinkarnasi ke Masa Lalu Dimulai dari Hukuman Penggal~
堤亞穆帝國物語～從斷頭台開始，公主重生後的逆轉人生～
description:
Twenty-year-old Princess Mia of the Tearmoon Empire, often scorned as the "selfish princess," was executed by guillotine in a rebellion. Next thing she knew, she awoke in her own twelve-year-old body, with her own blood-stained diary that she kept before she was beheaded sitting next to her pillow. Given a second chance at life, Mia decides to rebuild the empire. For the sake of Tearmoon's future? To save the people from starvation? For all the soldiers who lost their lives in the civil war? No! Everything she does in this life is for the sake of avoiding the guillotine! "F-For me, this should be a piece of cake!" Thus the useless, cowardly, self-serving princess brings about miracle after miracle in her great struggle to save herself in this altered-history fantasy.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

node.description:
This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work. 

Please add other narrator characters, which were given a visual representation of themselves, separately from this narrator page.

name.native: ミーア・ルーナ・ティアムーン

node.description:
__Home town:__ Tearmoon Empire / Lunatear (Imperial Capital) / Whitemoon Palace

The Tearmoon Empire's one and only Princess. Lazy, selfish, and a complete coward. She doesn't have a specific goal and only care about herself. She's 12 by the time she first attends to Saint-Noel Academy.

A few years later, the Empire was in ruins under a financial crisis, a famine and an epidemic that caused the death of 10% of its population. By the time Mia was 17, the revolutionary army caught her while on the run, she was imprisoned in an underground cell for 3 years and then she died by guillotine at the age of 20.

After that, Mia woke up in her bed as her 11-year-old self remembering her death by guillotine very clearly which left her terrified. She still cares only about herself but because of that she has now a goal and that is to avoid the future of being executed by guillotine.

name.native: アンヌ・リトシュタイン

node.description:
One of [Mia](https://anilist.co/character/172654)'s loyal retainers. She's known to be a little clumsy in her duties as a maid. The eldest daughter of the Littstein family. From a commoner and poor origin, she didn't come to the Whitemoon Palace to dedicate her life to loyal servitude to the imperial family but because she was in need of money.

In the previous timeline, by the time Mia was imprisoned, a few people had come to see Mia for the first few weeks but their visits ended as soon as they realized that she would never claim the throne. Only Anne kept visiting her, not waiting more than a day or two between visits. Sometimes she would bring snacks. Other times she would come with water and a washcloth. Knowing that Mia couldn't bathe, Anne would wash her as best she could and tidy up her clothes. Day after day, week after week, she came, her loyalty unfaltering. On the day of Mia's execution, Mia made her way toward the guillotine regretting that she could do nothing to repay this faithful maid's devotion and kindness.

In the timeline of the main story, Mia remembered what Anne did for her and, as a repay for Anne's devotion to her, she appointed Anne as her personal maid-in-waiting.

name.native: ルードヴィッヒ・ヒューイット

node.description:
__Home town:__ Tearmoon Empire One of [Mia](https://anilist.co/character/172654)'s loyal retainers. The second son of a mercantile family, he had been a bright spark ever since he was a young boy. He'd always dreamed of becoming a government official, but it didn't take him long to realize just how rotten to the core the Tearmoon Empire was after he began studying towards his goal. It was because of this that he truly despised those blueblooded nobles and the imperial family. Disciple of the [Wandering Sage](https://anilist.co/character/220655). In the previous timeline, he was a tax official in a department at the Imperial Capital but was transferred to a department in the country-side by the time Mia was 11. During the Empire's financial crisis, he tried very hard to convince the others to rebuild the Empire. Even though he despises the nobility, due to a certain event, he changed his mind towards Mia. By the time Mia was imprisoned, he was running around proposing for Mia's release. In the timeline of the main story, he remained working at the Imperial Capital and, due to a display of "wisdom" from Mia, he swore his loyalty to her...
_(Spoiler from Volume 4 of the LN)_ ~!...but, it will be much later when he realizes the true essence of Mia and reaffirms his loyalty not to "The Empire's Wisdom" but to "Mia", like he did in the previous timeline.!~

__Home town:__ Kingdom of Remno / Fedscoud Castle Second Prince of the Kingdom of Remno. He is a kind-hearted boy who treats women like a gentleman. However, in the Kingdom of Remno, where swordsmanship is held in high esteem and tend to be male dominated, he was often called a "weakling" for his character. In particular, he had been losing to his brother [Gain](https://anilist.co/character/220621), the first prince, who is two years older than him, in swordsmanship practice, and when he was shown [Sion](https://anilist.co/character/220617)'s swordsmanship, which is superior to his brother's, he was seized with resignation. In the previous timeline, he had no connection to [Mia](https://anilist.co/character/172654) at all and was renowned as a rare playboy. He was eventually assassinated by [Monica Buendia](https://anilist.co/character/220644). In the timeline of the main story, he was looked up to by Mia as "a place of exile in case the revolution of the Tearmoon Empire could not be prevented", and his confidence grew as a result of his friendship with her. Ultimately, through unrelenting self-improvement, he mastered swordsmanship and scholarship that rivaled even Sion.
_(Spoiler from Volume 3 of the LN)_ ~!In addition, he and Mia fall in love with each other, but at present time they are more than friends but less than lovers. In an alternative timeline future, he married Mia and had eight children. He is also the grandfather of [Miabel Luna Tearmoon](https://anilist.co/character/220646).!~

name.native: ラフィーナ・オルカ・ヴェールガ

node.description:
__Birthday season:__ Spring (early)
__Home town:__ Holy Principality of Belluga

The daughter of Duke Orleans, the ruler of the Holy Principality of Belluga where Saint-Noel Academy is located. The president of the student council and effective ruler of Saint-Noel Academy, where aristocrats and royalty such as [Mia](https://anilist.co/character/172654) and [Sion](https://anilist.co/character/220617) attend. She is a true saint who does not care about her status, treats ordinary people and nobles alike, and while giving mercy to them, she has a fastidious personality, values justice, and can judge others mercilessly.

In the previous timeline, she had little contact with Mia, but rather intentionally refused to have a relationship with Mia. She supported [the leader](https://anilist.co/character/220615) of the revolutionary army.

There was no one she could call her "friend", but in the timeline of the main story, she became friends with Mia and was saved through this relationship.
node.age: 14 (Initial Age), 1 grade older than Mia at Saint-Noel

name.native: ティオーナ・ルドルフォン

node.description:
The eldest daughter of Outland Count [Rudolvon](https://anilist.co/character/220635), who owns a territory in the southern frontier of the Tearmoon Empire. In the empire, the Outland Count is considered a lower class noble, and in order to overcome the adversity, she is a talented woman who not only studies but is also good at swordsmanship. Her family consists of her father, the head of the Rudolvon Outland Count family, and her brother [Cyril Rudolvon](https://anilist.co/character/220634), who is two years younger. She is also on good terms with her maid, [Liora Lulu](https://anilist.co/character/220616), beyond her master-servant relationship, and is fond of her.

In the previous timeline, she led the revolutionary army, became an empire's saint, and witnessed [Mia](https://anilist.co/character/172654)'s execution. Because of this, she is one of Mia's enemies along with [Sion](https://anilist.co/character/220617) and [Rafina](https://anilist.co/character/220619).

In the timeline of the main story, due to her experience in the previous timeline, Mia initially wanted to avoid contact with Tiona, but after many twists and turns she was saved by Mia and became one of her admirers.

Mascot of the Tearmoon Empire's franchise. Life-like representation of a guillotine that torments [Mia](https://anilist.co/character/172654)'s thoughts.
_Note: Its name's pronunciation sounds very similar to "guillotine" in Japanese._

__Home town:__ Tearmoon Empire / Sealence Forest A maid who serves [Tiona Rudolvon](https://anilist.co/character/220615). A native of the Lulu tribe, a minority ethnic group that lives in the forest area "Sealence Forest" that stretches across the border between the [Rudolvon](https://anilist.co/character/220635) Outland Count and [Berman](https://anilist.co/character/220629) Viscount territories. Many of the Lulu tribe are unfamiliar with the official language of the continent, and she is no exception, with a stuttering way of speaking. She is a master archer and has high physical ability. She is attached to her master, Tiona, and has a bond with her like her sister. In the previous timeline, there was a deep connection with [Mia](https://anilist.co/character/172654), and Liora hated Mia to the point of wanting to kill her. In the timeline of the main story, when Mia accidentally helped Tiona when she entered Saint-Noel Academy, a point of contact was created, and the fate of the incident was prevented by Mia's quick wit, so she has a good feeling for her.
_Note: The cover image is a chibi version of her._

name.native: クロエ・フォークロード

node.description: She's a timid girl whose defining features are her thick crop of black hair and even thicker glasses. She came from a family of merchants who ran a fairly large business. Given more to books than to banter, she has a much more reserverd personality unlike her parents.

__Home town:__ Tearmoon Empire

The imperial army's mightiest swordman. His skills as a mercenary earned him an official rank in the imperial army, where he could become a squadron captain of 100 soldiers.

In the previous timeline, [Mia](https://anilist.co/character/172654)'s selfish desire for a jewelry box sparked a conflict in Sealence Forest, resulting in a tragedy that killed all of Dion's subordinates. Soon after the revolution broke out, Dion sided with the revolutionary army's cause, where he played a major role in bringing down the imperial army by slaughtering famous generals with his sword. The man only sought one thing as a reward for his stellar contributions, princess Mia's head. Ultimately, he got what he was looking for and became Mia's executioner at the guillotine.

In the timeline of the main story, his first encounter with Mia was so abrupt for her that she panicked and promptly passed out on the spot. Having experienced his mercilessness directly and all, Mia is completely terrified of him.

name.native: シオン・ソール・サンクランド

node.description:
First Prince of the Kingdom of Sunkland, a country that boasted a proud lineage and power on par with the Tearmoon Empire. He is an all-around genius who displays great talent in everything, and is a good young man who strives for "fairness" and "justice". In the previous timeline, he was one of the enemies who condemned [Mia](https://anilist.co/character/172654) as "an incompetent ruler", helped [the leader](https://anilist.co/character/220615) of the revolutionary army, and was present at Mia's execution.
_(Spoiler from Volume 2 of the LN)_ ~!By the way, his evaluation of Mia in the previous timeline was not based on his own direct discussion or turning with Mia, but on her superficial behavior and evaluation of people around her, that is, __just from rumors__. For this reason, although his behavior toward Mia was "correct" as a result of "her actions", it's actually quite problematic from a bird's eye view. For that reason, [Ludwig](https://anilist.co/character/220609), who knew all about Mia, a human being, for better or for worse, rejected to work for Sion because he was "an ideal monarch who never made a mistake" _but because of that he probably will never understand how Mia felt... and how much she tried_.!~

__Home town:__ Kingdom of Sunkland

A follower of [Sion Sol Sunkland](https://anilist.co/character/220617), the first prince of the Kingdom of Sunkland. Originally a war orphan, he was taken in by [Abram](https://anilist.co/character/290192), the current king, and raised like his own son. Because of this, he and Sion have grown up together like brothers, and they sometimes cross the boundaries of their relationship and treat each other frankly as if he were his own son. Although he is eccentric and cynical, he is at heart a loyal and sincere young man.

In the timeline of the main story, he is constantly at the mercy of Sion and [Mia](https://anilist.co/character/172654), which causes him a lot of trouble. He is also a mushroom aficionado, and although he explains the dangers of poisonous mushrooms to Mia, she has a hard time listening to him.

__Home town:__ Tearmoon Empire

The head chef at the Whitemoon Palace. His duty is caring for the health of the imperial family.

In the previous timeline, Mia fired him on her 14th birthday because he only served dishes containing vegetables she disliked (especially ambermoon tomatoes).

name.native: エリス・リトシュタイン

node.description:
__Home town:__ Tearmoon Empire / Lunatear (Imperial Capital)

[Anne](https://anilist.co/character/220608)'s younger sister and second daughter of the Littstein family. She is naturally sick and usually stays in bed. Her hobby is writing novels, and she is also the author of the story Anne told to [Mia](https://anilist.co/character/172654) in prison in the previous timeline.

In the previous timeline, she died before Mia's execution, partly due to her lack of acquaintance and lack of a satisfying meal. For Mia, who was living in prison at the time, Elise's story was one of her few pleasures, but it was left unfinished because of Elise' death, and Mia regretted not being able to see the end of the work.

In the timeline of the main story, Anne's salary has increased since she became Mia's personal maid-in-waiting, and Elise is feeling relatively better because she can eat nutritious food. When Mia visits Anne's parents' house, she finds out that Elise was the author of the story, and makes her her own artist. 

In the near future, she will author a book entitled "The Chronicles of Saint Princess Mia", which played an important role in the development of the Volume 3 of the LN.

name.native: マティアス・ルーナ・ティアムーン

node.description:
__Home town:__ Tearmoon Empire / Lunatear (Imperial Capital) / Whitemoon Palace

The current emperor of the Tearmoon Empire and [Mia](https://anilist.co/character/172654)'s father. He deeply loved [his late wife](https://anilist.co/character/290198) and has not remarried even after her passing. He is famous for his love for Mia. He persistently tells Mia "Call me daddy", but she constantly refuses to call him that. In the previous timeline, he was executed before Mia.

name.native: モニカ・ブエンディア

node.description:
__Home town:__ Tearmoon Empire, Berman Viscounty The head of the Viscount Berman family, which has a fief next to the [Rudolvon](https://anilist.co/character/220635) family. He's concerned that his territory is smaller than that of the Outland Count Rudolvon, who seems to look down on him as a county aristocrat, and he plans to forcefully cultivate the Sealence Forest located between their territories. In the previous timeline, this led to the outbreak of civil unrest among the Lulu tribe, which eventually led to the destruction of the empire. In the timeline of the main story, [Mia](https://anilist.co/character/172654) successfully dealt with the above problems and he became a loyal subject who devoted a great deal of loyalty to Mia.
_(Spoiler from the Volume 3 of the LN)_ ~!His loyalty was so great that he supported the imperial family even after Mia's death, even in an alternative timeline future (the future in which [Miabel](https://anilist.co/character/220646) was born), which diverged from the timeline of the main story.!~

__Home town:__ Tearmoon Empire / Outland County of Rudolvon

The eldest son of Outland Count [Rudolvon](https://anilist.co/character/220635) and younger brother of [Tiona](https://anilist.co/character/220615). A young but scholarly person who likes to research, mainly good at botany.

In the previous timeline, his research was fruitful and the development of 'wheat resistant to cold' saved food shortages in the territory, and played a major role for the revolutionary army in gaining popularity.

In the timeline of the main story, [Mia](https://anilist.co/character/172654) remembers this when she interacts with Tiona and carries out a 'plan' to show his abilities in the Empire as a means of countering the future.

__Home town:__ Tearmoon Empire / Outland County of Rudolvon

The head of the Outland Count Rudolvon family, father of [Tiona](https://anilist.co/character/220615) and [Cyril](https://anilist.co/character/220634).
